The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: End User Support and IT Infrastructure
description:
We are seeking a skilled End User Support and IT Infrastructure with expertise in End User support, IT Operations, and Networking to join our team. As an Infrastructure, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's IT infrastructure, ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of our systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business operations and ensure the smooth functioning of our technology infrastructure.

Your mission:

  • Deploy, configure, and manage server infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage systems, and backup solutions
  • Collaborate with IT teams to ensure effective planning, implementation, and maintenance of server infrastructure to meet business requirements
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize server infrastructure for performance and scalability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth IT operations, including user support, system maintenance, and software deployments
  • Develop and maintain documentation, including system configurations, standard operating procedures, and infrastructure diagrams
  • Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements in the design and operation of infrastructure systems
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and processes to improve infrastructure efficiency and reliability
  • Participate in disaster recovery planning, including backup strategies, data replication, and failover procedures
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to infrastructure engineering and networking
  • Continuous development of the IT process automation and system landscape
  • First contact person for all IT Administration related topics (user support) in our Florianopolis office
  • Technical responsibility for planning and the implementation IT infrastructure project tasks in our Brazil offices, considering the corporate IT strategy and budget

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

To join our team, YOU must HAVE:

  • Completed degree in Computer Science or training as an IT Specialist or comparable qualification
  • Several years proven experience with End User Support, IT infrastructure administration, server infrastructure, IT operations, and networking.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft tools.
  • Experience in SharePoint, Jira and Confluence tools, operational, migrations, backups
  • Proficiency in networking concepts, protocols, and technologies (e.g., TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, firewalls)
  • Familiarity with IT operations management tools and practices, such as monitoring, incident management, and change management
  • Know-how in administration of Windows, Apple, and Linux systems
  • Solid understanding of security principles and best practices in infrastructure design and operations
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure) is desirable
  • Analyse and resolve equipment problems: laptops, servers, printers, networks
  • Very Good English communication skills
  • Knowledge on CrowdStrike, Manage Engine, Asset Explorer, Intune, Netskope or similar

And YOU must BE:

  • Able to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Structured and having an independent and reliable working style
  • Open-minded with strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Having excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Be proactive and have good communication
  • Good relationship with colleagues and clients
  • Familiar with GDPR and ISO 27001 rules and guidelines

title: Gerente de Curadoria
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Curadoria com perfil estratégico, técnico e relacional, para atuar na construção da presença institucional do grupo AML em eventos, congressos, plataformas digitais e publicações especializadas.

O(a) profissional será responsável pela curadoria, planejamento e execução de conteúdos e painéis técnicos sobre PLD/FTP, ESG, Compliance e Integridade , além de liderar o relacionamento com palestrantes, especialistas e entidades parceiras.

Essa posição exige capacidade de articulação institucional, conhecimento técnico sobre integridade corporativa e perfil voltado à influência e reputação , garantindo que todas as iniciativas do grupo reflitam credibilidade, consistência e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Planejar e coordenar os painéis, mesas e plenárias dos congressos e eventos técnicos promovidos ou apoiados pelo grupo.
  • Definir pautas e linhas editoriais alinhadas às temáticas de PLD/FTP, ESG, Governança e Integridade.
  • Recrutar e gerir a participação de palestrantes, conteudistas e especialistas convidados , garantindo pluralidade técnica e relevância institucional.
  • Supervisionar o desenvolvimento de conteúdos para site institucional, redes sociais, webinars, reuniões de comissões e newsletters.
  • Gerir o calendário editorial de publicações técnicas (artigos, papers, white papers e relatórios).
  • Garantir coerência entre a comunicação institucional e os princípios de integridade e compliance que norteiam o grupo.
  • Acompanhar e apoiar o time de comunicação e marketing na produção de materiais, campanhas e coberturas de eventos.
  • Representar o grupo em reuniões de alinhamento com instituições parceiras, universidades, órgãos regulatórios e imprensa especializada.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com o Instituto IPLD , contribuindo para a atualização contínua das pautas técnicas e temáticas regulatórias.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento estratégico com formadores de opinião, especialistas e representantes de entidades nacionais e internacionais ligadas ao setor.

Perfil Desejado

  • Experiência comprovada em relações públicas corporativas, curadoria de conteúdo, organização de eventos técnicos ou gestão de congressos voltados à PLD/FTP .
  • Forte capacidade de articulação institucional e relacionamento com stakeholders de alto nível (autoridades, reguladores, executivos e acadêmicos).
  • Conhecimento técnico nas áreas de PLD/FTP, ESG, Compliance, Governança e Integridade Corporativa .
  • Perfil organizado, diplomático e orientado à entrega de valor institucional , com visão estratégica e atenção a detalhes.
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para mediação e condução de apresentações e eventos.
  • Formação superior em Comunicação, Relações Públicas, Direito, Relações Internacionais, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação em Compliance, ESG, Gestão Pública ou Comunicação Institucional é um diferencial.
  • Inglês avançado (e espanhol desejável) para interlocução com instituições e palestrantes internacionais.

title: HR Business Partner (individual contributor position)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for your curiosity

We’re driven by ambition and guided by a bold vision for the years ahead. As we scale our profitable ecosystem of tools and services, we’re seeking a dedicated and adaptable HR Business Partner – Brazil (individual contributor position) to help us bring our People strategy to life and support our teams on the ground.

In this position, you will report directly to the Director of People and work closely with leaders and employees to ensure that People processes run efficiently and consistently. This is an individual contributor role with a strong execution component — combining hands-on delivery with collaboration and influence across regional and global teams.

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers — from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, and department stores to fashion brands — across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, and Colombia.

We have three key products:

  1. Flexifleet – Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.
  2. Fulfillment Optimizer – Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing, and delivery.
  3. Consumer Connect – AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability.

Backed by over USD 70 million in venture capital , we’ve delivered consistent growth and completed 100+ million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across Latin America — and this is just the beginning.

Who you are

You are a hands-on HR professional who enjoys being close to the business and the people. You combine empathy, structure, and a strong sense of ownership to deliver high-quality results.

You thrive in dynamic environments, balancing operational priorities with thoughtful, people-centered solutions. You’re someone who makes things happen while building trust and collaboration across teams.

What you will do

  1. Partner with business leaders and employees across Brazil to provide day-to-day support on key HR processes — from onboarding and employee relations to development and engagement.
  2. Deliver a best-in-class onboarding experience.
  3. Implement surveys, analyze data, and develop action plans to close gaps.
  4. Manage Rewards and Incentives: leverage current compensation and incentive plans, as well as benchmarking against other companies and industries to ensure our schemes are fit for the future.
  5. Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
  6. Protect the organization’s value by keeping information confidential.
  7. Comply with local legal requirements by studying existing and new legislation; enforcing adherence to requirements; advising management on needed actions.
  8. Participate in developing department goals, objectives, and systems.
  9. Handle employee relations counseling, outplacement counseling, and exit interviews.
  10. Own the plan and logistics of internal events.
  11. Implement and sustain People initiatives , ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
  12. Manage HR operations and documentation with accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
  13. Work closely with regional people partners to align priorities, localize global programs, and ensure effective implementation in Brazil.

The skills and experience you will bring

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields.
  2. 4+ years of experience in HR, ideally as a Business Partner in fast-paced or tech environments.
  3. Strong understanding of Brazilian labor legislation and HR best practices.
  4. Experience in employee relations, HR operations, and process implementation.
  5. Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  6. Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  7. Proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in helping teams succeed.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
️ Position: Associate Principal – Cloud Architecture (Azure PaaS Modernization)

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type: Full-Time / Contractor (depending on region)

About the Role

We are seeking an Associate Principal – Architecture with strong technical leadership and deep expertise in Azure PaaS application modernization . This role focuses on designing target-state cloud architectures, leading modernization and migration efforts, and guiding engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate brings a balance of hands-on technical depth , architectural strategy, and the ability to lead and mentor technical teams .

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute modernization and migration initiatives to Azure PaaS services (e.g., App Service, Azure Functions, AKS, Container Instances).
  • Conduct application modernization assessments , develop target-state cloud architectures, and define migration roadmaps.
  • Optimize hosting, performance, scalability, cost efficiency , and system reliability.
  • Provide technical leadership to teams of 5+ engineers, ensuring architectural alignment and delivery excellence.
  • Design and implement Azure Landing Zones following best practices for security, governance, and networking.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data, DevOps, and Integration teams to ensure end-to-end solution coherence.
  • Assess and tune application performance before and after migration.

Technical Requirements

  • 13+ years of experience in application development and modernization.
  • Strong hands-on experience migrating and hosting applications on Azure PaaS (App Services, Functions, AKS).
  • Experience with IIS hosting , containerization, and Kubernetes-based runtime environments.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, integrations, networking, and security patterns .
  • Working knowledge of database connectivity, caching, session management, and configuration best practices .
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and optimize Azure application environments .

Leadership Expectations

  • Experience leading teams of 5+ engineers , with the ability to mentor, coach, and guide.
  • Capable of aligning technical direction to business priorities and delivering to timelines.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement.

Soft Skills

  • Clear, concise communication in English (written and spoken).
  • Strong client-facing and presentation skills.
  • Collaborative mindset and positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making ability.

title: Data Modeler

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

title: Finance Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Operations Analyst to join our growing finance team. This role is essential to ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, from end-to-end payment execution and accounting control to tax compliance and audit-ready documentation.

The ideal candidate has a solid background in end-to-end payment processing, a strong understanding of the banking environment, experience with domestic and international transactions (FX payments), and the accounting knowledge required to accurately book and reconcile all financial movements. Additionally, this person will have a solid grasp of withholding tax requirements, the ability to issue service invoices (NFS-e), and a strong focus on internal controls and documentation processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment and collaborate closely with teams in Brazil, Singapore, and Japan.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Payment Operations

  • Manage the full accounts payable cycle, including receiving, reviewing, and verifying invoices for accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Execute and monitor domestic and foreign currency (FX) payments, including supplier invoices, intercompany transactions, and service fees.
  • Operate banking platforms with accuracy and control, ensuring timely payment execution and proper approval workflows.
  • Track and manage payment terms, proactively resolving discrepancies and maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Coordinate with BPO providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues and provide regular payment status updates.
  • Review, validate, and process employee reimbursement claims, ensuring policy compliance, complete documentation, and readiness for audits.
  • Support the continuous improvement of payment procedures and contribute to the development of updated policies and standard operating procedures to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Tax and Invoicing

  • Identify, calculate, and control withholding taxes such as IRRF, ISS, PIS/COFINS, and INSS on supplier invoices and service payments.
  • Ensure proper tax treatment and accurate accounting of all transactions, including cross-border payments.
  • Prepare and issue service invoices (NFS-e) for intercompany and third-party transactions in compliance with municipal regulations and internal policies.
  • Support tax reconciliations, documentation, and reporting required for audits and statutory filings.

Accounting, Reporting, and Internal Controls

  • Accurately record, classify, and reconcile all payment transactions in the general ledger, ensuring proper accounting treatment.
  • Support the maintenance of the chart of accounts, including the creation and updating of GL accounts and cost centers.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities and prepare financial reporting packages for submission to the headquarters in Singapore.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing and organizing documentation that meets governance and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to building and strengthening internal controls, documentation standards, and compliance processes across all payment, accounting, and tax operations.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or above).
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in accounts payable, payment processing, treasury operations, accounting, or similar finance roles, preferably in a multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian payment processes, tax obligations, and withholding tax requirements.
  • Proven experience issuing service invoices (NFS-e) and ensuring compliance with fiscal requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with FX payments, international transactions, and corporate banking platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Solid knowledge of internal controls, documentation standards, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and international teams.

Why Join Us

  • You will be part of a dynamic finance team that plays a strategic role in our company’s expansion and operations in Brazil. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in payments, accounting, tax compliance, and internal controls while contributing to the growth of a global organization with strong connections to Singapore and Japan.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.

Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Company Description

RockSpoon is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our team on-site in São Paulo. In this leadership role, you will craft and oversee user experiences that are exceptionally intuitive, requiring no training or tooltips for users. You will champion a design philosophy that emphasizes clarity, minimalism, and intuitive design thinking to achieve outstanding usability across our product line. Working across our cross-platform suite (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS), you will leverage effective visual hierarchy, layout, and interaction cues to guide users effortlessly. This full-time position involves collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers; you will also mentor team members and shape our design system to deliver an exceptional user experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead intuitive UX design: Lead the design of clear, self-explanatory user interfaces and workflows. Leverage visual hierarchy, layout, and intuitive interaction cues to guide users, ensuring the product is so intuitive that no training or tooltips are needed.
  • Product design strategy: Drive the UX/UI design strategy with a strong focus on usability, minimalism, and intuitive design principles. Align design objectives with product goals to deliver a simple, elegant, and highly usable experience for users.
  • Cross-platform oversight: Oversee and contribute to the design of features across mobile and desktop platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). Ensure a consistent, seamless user experience that respects platform-specific guidelines while maintaining a unified product identity.
  • Design and prototyping: Create detailed wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate design concepts. Iterate quickly based on feedback and usability findings to refine the user experience.
  • Design system ownership: Own and evolve RockSpoon’s design system and style guides. Establish UI standards and reusable components that promote a cohesive, intuitive, and minimalist interface across all products.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders from concept through launch. Ensure feasibility of designs and a smooth handoff to development, while advocating for the best user experience.
  • Mentorship and leadership: Mentor and provide guidance to mid-level and junior designers. Foster a culture of user-centered, intuitive design thinking within the team through knowledge sharing, code/design reviews, and continuous feedback.
  • User research & testing: Champion user research and usability testing efforts. Plan or participate in user interviews, UI tests, and analytics reviews to validate design decisions, using insights to continuously improve the product’s clarity and ease of use.
  • Usability and accessibility standards: Ensure all designs meet high standards for usability and accessibility. Deliver a frictionless, responsive experience for a diverse user base, and refine interactions to eliminate pain points and confusion.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a similar role, with significant experience leading design projects or initiatives. Proven track record of delivering successful and intuitive digital products or features.
  • Portfolio: An outstanding portfolio showcasing your product design work. Should include examples of complex applications you’ve made simple through intuitive design, demonstrating excellent usability, visual clarity, and minimalistic style.
  • Expert UX/UI knowledge: Deep knowledge of user experience principles and interaction design. Comfortable with information architecture, user flows, and usability heuristics. Ability to simplify complex workflows and create interfaces that feel natural to users.
  • Cross-platform expertise: Extensive experience designing for a range of platforms – native mobile (iOS and Android) and web/desktop applications. Familiarity with the best practices and constraints of each platform, and ability to create cohesive experiences across them.
  • Design tools & systems: Mastery of design and prototyping tools, especially Figma. Strong experience in building or maintaining design systems and component libraries. Able to enforce and evolve a consistent design language at scale.
  • Leadership & collaboration: Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead design discussions, clearly communicate design rationale, and influence product strategy. Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams and working closely with engineering and product management.
  • Intuitive design mindset: Demonstrated intuitive design thinking and problem-solving ability. Passion for usability and minimalism – you instinctively design solutions that feel easy and obvious to the end user, without extraneous complexity.
  • Communication & language: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (required for daily use). Portuguese language skills are a plus and will be helpful in the local office environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: Software Engineer, Data Integrations
description:
Blawk is building next-generation infrastructure to automate and analyze financial data at scale across the entertainment and creator economy.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Data Integrations) to help design and develop reliable automation pipelines for ingesting, mapping, and enriching large datasets from multiple external platforms. You’ll play a key role in connecting Blawk’s backend systems to external data sources, ensuring our data remains accurate, normalized, and scalable.

You’ll collaborate closely with our Founding Engineer to bring new data integrations online, enhance our normalization logic, and improve the reliability of ingestion across multiple environments.

This will start part-time, and advance to Full-time depending on performance. 

What the Candidate Will Do

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and data ingestion pipelines from external dashboards or portals.
  • Build data mappers that convert multiple schemas into a unified internal data model.
  • Implement error handling, logging, and monitoring for all ingestion jobs.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to refine the database structure and enrichment logic.
  • Document integration workflows to support scalability and future maintenance.
  • Work independently with clear milestones while communicating progress proactively.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering , preferably in backend or automation-heavy environments.
  • Strong coding skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, mainly inside NestJS and Node.js
  • Strong Experience integrating front end with backend applications such as Next.js 
  • Experience with web automation frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of SQL-based data modeling and transformation pipelines.
  • Working proficiency in English (does not need to be fluent but able to communicate clearly with the team).
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver production-quality code with minimal oversight
  • Algorithm & Data Structures fundamentals, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked list, DFS, BFS.
  • Experience in hands-on software development with thoughtfulness of scale, latency and distributed architecture.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, or other modern cloud databases .
  • Background in ETL pipelines, data normalization, or automation frameworks .
  • Familiarity with browser automation, headless environments, or task scheduling tools & Queue managers. 
  • Passion for building reliable data systems that simplify complex workflows.

Bonus If

  • experience working in media, entertainment, or fintech data systems.
  • Experience with international stakeholders

title: (Contract) Psychotherapist / Psychologist
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist (Hybrid: Remote & In-Person)

Location: Marau, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.

What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.

Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in Marau.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.

If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.

Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:

Members Come First We are genuine member advocates.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.

Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager
description:
About Dacxi Chain

Dacxi Chain is building the critical infrastructure for the future of global capital formation. As the world's first tokenized crowdfunding infrastructure, we're creating the foundational layer that enables entrepreneurs to connect with everyday investors worldwide through blockchain technology. By tokenizing company shares on our infrastructure, we're eliminating traditional barriers like geographical borders and limited liquidity - making capital raising seamless for businesses and investment opportunities accessible to everyone, everywhere. We're not just creating a platform; we're architecting the essential infrastructure that will power the next generation of crowdfunding - transparent, scalable, and globally accessible.

Job Description: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager

We are searching for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager to lead our most critical initiatives. This advanced hybrid role combines the governance of a PMO, the hands-on coordination of a Delivery Manager, and the technical depth of a Project Manager. You will also be entrusted with key Product Owner responsibilities, acting as the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders. Your mission is to ensure projects are not only delivered on time and within budget but also align with our strategic product vision and maintain the highest quality standards.

Important: This role is only open to candidates based in Brazil , and requires fluent Portuguese and fluent English .

This is a fully remote position, working with teams across Brazil, the UK, and New Zealand.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Governance & Technical PMO:

  • Develop, refine, and enforce technical project management methodologies and best practices across the organization.
  • Manage and maintain a comprehensive RAID log, proactively identifying and mitigating potential roadblocks.
  • Maintain a decision log to document and track key project decisions, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Oversee an action log, holding all team members and stakeholders accountable for their commitments.
  • Implement "Planned vs. Actual" reporting to track project performance against initial baselines, highlighting deviations in scope, schedule, and budget.

Delivery & Release Management:

  • Serve as the central point of contact for project coordination, facilitating communication and collaboration between product, development, QA, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams across different time zones.
  • Partner with QA to ensure testing is integrated seamlessly into the project lifecycle, from early-stage validation to final quality assurance.
  • Coordinate with GTM teams to align on release schedules and ensure a smooth, well-prepared launch of new products or features.
  • Orchestrate and manage the end-to-end release process, ensuring all dependencies are met and risks are mitigated.
  • Hold product and engineering teams accountable for their commitments, ensuring deliverables are met on time and to the required standard.

Project & Product Ownership:

  • Lead the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning to execution and post-mortem analysis.
  • Act as the Product Owner for specific initiatives, ensuring the development team's work aligns with the overall product roadmap.
  • Translate business and user needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.
  • Proactively identify and address potential pitfalls, technical debt, and risks to ensure the project stays on track.
  • Provide high-quality, data-driven reporting to leadership and stakeholders, offering transparent insights into project status and performance.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in a technical project management role, with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated experience with PMO functions, including process standardization, governance, and portfolio management.
  • Must be currently based in Brazil and fluent in both written and verbal Portuguese and English.
  • Expertise in managing project documentation, specifically RAID logs, decision logs, and action logs.
  • A track record of successfully holding cross-functional teams accountable for their deliverables.
  • Experience performing Product Owner duties, such as managing a product backlog and defining user stories.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of coordinating development, QA, and GTM teams across global locations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights from metrics like "planned vs. actual".
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CSM, SAFe, or similar) are highly desirable.

Preferred Skills:

  • Innovative Mindset: A forward-thinking approach, staying ahead of industry and technology trends.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven decision-making approach.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to manage expectations and keep technical and non-technical stakeholders aligned.
  • Execution & Ownership: Strong sense of ownership, with a track record of driving complex projects to completion on time and to quality.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams.
  • Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, adjusting plans as priorities evolve.

This role is for a proactive leader who is passionate about both the big picture and the details. If you're ready to define processes, drive technical delivery, hold teams accountable, and help shape our product vision, we want to hear from you.

Interested?

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! Join us in revolutionizing the global funding landscape at Dacxi Chain.

title: Consultor(a) Laboratório
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Oferecer suporte técnico laboratorial através do mapeamento e monitoramento dos processos, matérias-primas e produto, garantindo a confiabilidade dos dados analíticos, padronização de métodos e suporte à tomada de decisão na operação industrial. Gerir recursos, sistemas e realizar a gestão técnica dos analistas da sua área de atuação, contribuindo com projetos de melhoria contínua, inovação tecnológica e atendimento a requisitos normativos e de clientes. Assegurar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade e segurança, bem como, fornecer suporte técnico às demais áreas de interface.

Principais Atividades:

  • Profissional será responsável pela implementação, validação e otimização de metodologias analíticas , assegurando a qualidade e eficiência dos processos e produtos. Atuar na gestão de recursos laboratoriais , planejamento e acompanhamento de produção, com foco em conformidade técnica e regulatória;
  • Liderar o treinamento e capacitação da equipe , garantindo prontidão operacional e suporte técnico durante o startup da planta. Propor e executar melhorias contínuas por meio da análise de processos, adoção de novas tecnologias e práticas sustentáveis;
  • Realizar o monitoramento e supervisão das rotinas analíticas , controle de indicadores de desempenho e análise crítica de equipamentos e processos. Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de produção, manutenção, segurança e logística, colaborando em projetos de inovação, eficiência e qualidade;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar a gestão orçamentária do laboratório , negociação de contratos de manutenção e garantia da disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos sistemas. Comprometido com o cumprimento das normas de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (ISO, NRs) , promovendo uma cultura organizacional baseada em ética, conformidade e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos a vaga:

  • Ensino superior em Química, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Especialização em Celulose e Papel, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing e afins;
  • Sólida experiência em atividades e rotinas Laboratoriais;
  • Conhecimento no pacote Office, SAP e Power BI;
  • Vivência em Comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Inglês avançado e Espanhol será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em sistema LIMS será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Inocência/MS.

Essa posição é ideal para um profissional altamente analítico, colaborativo e orientado a sistemas, que se destaca em ambientes dinâmicos e de alto crescimento.

1. Estratégia e Planejamento

• Desenvolver previsões de receita consistentes, baseadas em pipeline, histórico e cenário de mercado;

• Definir segmentação, territórios, metas e alocação de recursos de forma alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento;

2. Programas de Incentivo e Remuneração

• Desenhar planos de compensação comercial alinhados às metas do negócio.

• Definir e distribuir cotas com base em capacidade, potencial de mercado e dados históricos.

• Gerenciar sistemas de comissionamento e garantir transparência nos cálculos.

3. Pricing e Suporte Comercial

• Criar e manter modelos de precificação e pacotes comerciais competitivos e padronizados.

• Oferecer suporte a deals complexos, incluindo análise de margem e aprovação de condições especiais.

• Estabelecer políticas de descontos e governança para negociações.

4. Otimização de Processos

• Mapear e melhorar processos do ciclo lead-to-cash, reduzindo fricções;

• Alinhar processos entre Marketing, Vendas e Sucesso do Cliente, garantindo handoffs eficientes.

5. Dados e Relatórios

• Desenvolver dashboards e análises sobre pipeline, taxa de conversão, churn e metas;

6. Sistemas e Ferramentas

• Participar da escolha, implementação e gestão de ferramentas como Salesforce e outras soluções de GTM;

• Configurar fluxos, automações e integrações que suportem processos escaláveis.

Requisitos

• Fluência em inglês;

• 7+ anos em Revenue Operations, Sales Operations ou Business Operations, incluindo liderança;

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.

Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.

We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION : Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

LOCATION : São Paulo / Brazil

JOB TYPE : Permanent

ROLE SENIORITY : Managerial

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Coordinates production with tollers, ensuring alignment with the sales plan, efficient execution, and resolution of conflicts and delays. Plans and manages the availability of materials and active ingredients (AI), executing MRP calculations, purchasing, and logistics coordination with suppliers. Monitors inventory levels, intercompany transfers, and toller performance, supporting continuous improvement in collaboration with supply chain and procurement teams.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

  • Owns toller coordination, ensuring production scheduling aligns with sales plan and demand priorities while maintaining adherence to frozen periods and committed production slots
  • Coordinates daily/weekly production plans with tollers, ensuring smooth execution by tracking output, resolving scheduling conflicts, and mitigating production delays. Works closely with the senior supply and planning specialist to align production priorities.
  • Monitors production execution, proactively identifying and addressing issues related to toller capacity, material shortages, or unexpected disruptions. Escalates unresolved risks to supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Owns material planning, ensures material availability of AI, co-formulants, and packaging readiness for planned production runs. Collaborates with suppliers and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Tracks and reports toller inventory levels, working with the Inventory Manager to identify potential shortages, excess stock, or discrepancies at toller sites.
  • Feeds production output data into ERP systems, ensuring visibility of completed batches and enabling accurate intercompany transfer orders, stock movements, and replenishment planning.
  • Collaborates with Logistics & Distribution, ensuring timely execution of intercompany transfers for finished goods and AI. Aligns outbound logistics, transportation planning, and carrier coordination to facilitate seamless material movement.
  • Provides input on toller performance, tracking adherence to schedules, production efficiency, and issue resolution. Supports continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Runs MRP calculations daily/weekly, ensuring accurate material replenishment by validating planning parameters such as lead times, order quantities, and safety stock. Drives improvement in planning accuracy by refining MRP parameters based on supply performance.
  • Updates MRP with supplier feedback, incorporating changes in lead times, production constraints, and delivery schedules to ensure material availability. Works closely with suppliers to proactively adjust for potential delays and optimize material flow.
  • Manages procurement execution, creating and tracking purchase orders for direct materials and AI.
  • Communicates material requirements to suppliers, validating availability against forecasts and ensuring timely deliveries.
  • Coordinates material and AI call-offs, ensuring timely deliveries from suppliers while optimizing logistics flows in collaboration with Distribution & Logistics. Monitors transportation lead times and ensure alignment with toller production schedules.
  • Acts as secondary support as senior supply and planning specialist in Conosur and Brazil according to the business needs.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
  • APICS certification strongly recommended;
  • Post-graduation is desired;
  • Project Management skills;
  • 3+ years cumulative experience in Supply Chain Planning & Tollers; Inventory Management;
  • Key competencies | Customer Focus, Teamwork, Drives Results, Analytics, Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving;
  • Assertive Communication, Leadership and influencing skills required;
  • Excellent knowledge of advanced planning principles, strategies, and systems;
  • Required fluent Spanish and English;
  • Availability for travel (15%)

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

description:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Como analista de negócios o papel será atender os clientes internos ou externos da Neoway sempre buscando entender os fluxos de tecnologia e negócios dos produtos e planos de negócios das áreas atendidas, fomentando evolução/inovação/melhoria contínua onde aplicável. Entendimento e mapeamento de negócios, análise de negócios, exploração de dados, desenvolvimento de KPIs, discussão técnica referente às tecnologias utilizadas (Neoway e cliente) e ambientes analíticos para desenvolvimento de solução e maior.

#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Levantamento de Requisitos: Colaborar com diferentes áreas e stakeholders (internos e externos) para entender as necessidades de negócio, mapeando requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Análise de Processos: Estudar e propor melhorias nos processos de negócios da empresa, garantindo eficiência e aderência às melhores práticas.
  • Modelagem de Soluções: Definir e documentar soluções tecnológicas que atendam às demandas levantadas, colaborando com as equipes de desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Interface com Equipes Técnicas e de Produto: Traduzir as necessidades de negócios para as equipes técnicas e garantir que as funcionalidades desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com os requisitos; promovendo também novas tecnologias e metodologias que possam ser aplicadas ao portfólio de produtos da empresa, avaliando a viabilidade de sua implementação.
  • Acompanhamento de Projetos: Auxiliar no gerenciamento de projetos, assegurando a entrega no prazo e dentro do escopo, com foco na qualidade da solução entregue.
  • Análise de Dados e Performance: Monitorar KPIs (Indicadores- chave de Desempenho) e métricas relacionadas aos processos de negócio, recomendando ajustes quando necessário.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação clara e organizada sobre os processos e soluções implementadas.

  • Experiência em SQL, Python e outras ferramentas de análise de dados e de visualização de dados como Power BI, por exemplo.

  • Familiaridade com Big Data, PySpark e modelos estatísticos.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para interação com diferentes áreas da empresa e clientes.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma eficiente e propor melhorias de processos.
  • Foco no Cliente: Entendimento das necessidades dos clientes e comprometimento em entregar soluções de alta qualidade.
  • Visão holística: de processos, do cliente e da Neoway para que possa atuar de forma crítica e propositiva/proativa;

#Diferencial:

  • Ter experiência com projetos de compliance, gestão de riscos, prevenção à fraudes e áreas correlatas;

  • Certificações em compliance, gestão de riscos ou prevenção à fraudes serão um diferencial.

title: New Merchant Growth Strategy
description:
About Us:

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'II Do:

  • Overall responsible for new merchant growth strategy.
  • Collaborate closely with frontline teams and merchants to collect merchant and management requirements, and distill them into overall strategies, including operational workflows and product functionalities.
  • Collaborate with relevant business teams to develop comprehensive product operation plans.
  • Monitor merchant usage of products in daily operations, collaborate with multiple teams to drive continuous iteration of product features, conduct product function training and promotion, and ensure the achievement of business objectives for product effectiveness.

What We Need From You:

  • Experience in project management and strategy. Familiar with strategy development, product operations, and common corporate methodologies.
  • Familiar with the merchant-side operations of e-commerce platforms. Priority will be given to those with experience in the food delivery industry.
  • Possesses excellent solution planning capabilities and has a basic understanding of B-end operational work. Demonstrates strong logical thinking skills.
  • Possesses excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills, achieving win-win results by integrating resources and cooperating with different business departments.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

  • Join a startup-like business. Opportunity to participate in the design of key business processes and products.
  • Grow alongside rapidly expanding businesses.
  • Work with members from 25 countries and experience a diverse work environment.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.

Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.

Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.

Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.

Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

Venha construir com a Insightful . Se esta oportunidade combina com você, candidate-se e vamos conversar!

Vivência em projetos de grande porte e ambientações imersivas.

description:
A DAIKIN é uma empresa multinacional japonesa com sede em Osaka, Japão, e é a maior fabricante de condicionadores de ar do mundo.

No Brasil há 12 anos, a DAIKIN BRASIL possui uma estrutura para atender Distribuidores e Usuários com equipes em São Paulo (SP), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Recife (PE) e Porto Alegre (RS). Na cidade de Manaus (AM), está localizada a unidade de produção com 350 funcionários, totalizando um quadro de 580 pessoas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e abordar novos clientes (comerciais, residenciais e instaladoras), comunicando de forma clara as vantagens técnicas dos produtos Daikin.
  • Prestar suporte comercial e administrativo à carteira de clientes B2B, varejo e instaladoras na região de Manaus e Norte, incluindo acompanhamento de pedidos e atendimento a demandas internas e externas.
  • Colaborar na resolução de questões técnicas e comerciais junto a instaladores, engenheiros e especificadores, garantindo um atendimento eficiente e orientado a detalhes.
  • Analisar o mercado e identificar oportunidades comerciais, apoiando o desenvolvimento de estratégias com base em dados, tendências e ações da concorrência, além de participar de iniciativas de trade marketing e ações de sell-out em campo.
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com empresas instaladoras, alinhando-se aos padrões da Daikin e adotando uma abordagem consultiva focada no público técnico.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior em Marketing, Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia no setor comercial/vendas;
  • Habilidade com Pacote Office (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Word) especialmente para relatórios e controle de vendas;
  • Noções das ISOs 9001, 14001 e 45001;
  • CNH-B e disponibilidade para trabalho em campo quando necessário;
  • Desejável conhecimento de ERP Protheus.
